title: Regulatory change → verified obligations
description: Deduplicate extracted obligations, verify each against the source text, an existing control, and evidence that the control operates, and block sign-off while any is open.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-qac-02
  title: Regulatory change → verified obligations
  description: Deduplicate extracted obligations, verify each against the source text, an existing control,
    and evidence that the control operates, and block sign-off while any is open.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Close a regulatory change with every obligation traced to a control and to evidence that
    the control actually operates, with open obligations listed rather than assumed covered.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: Regulatory change and current control set
      summary: Regulatory change and current control set
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - text
        properties:
          text:
            type: string
            description: The requester's objective, source material, or instructions.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - regulatory_texts
              - effective_dates
              - control_inventory
              - evidence_repository
            properties:
              regulatory_texts: {}
              effective_dates: {}
              control_inventory: {}
              evidence_repository: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: n-dedupe
      kind: transform
      name: Deduplicate claim set
      summary: deduplicate extracted obligations by normalized obligation text and citation
      config:
        operation: deduplicate
        expression: deduplicate extracted obligations by normalized obligation text and citation
    - id: n-verify1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: qac-01
      name: Verify obligation against the source text
      summary: 'Verification pass 1: verify obligation against the source text.'
      role: Monitor tracking regulatory change and translating it into obligations.
      prompt: You are a Regulatory Change Monitor. You track changes across the regulations that apply,
        and for each change you state the effective date, the transition provisions, and the specific
        obligations that are created, modified, or removed. You distinguish guidance from binding requirement,
        because treating the two the same produces either wasted work or an unmitigated gap.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - observability
          - contract-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - compliance-review
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: qac-02
      name: Verify a control exists that addresses it
      summary: 'Verification pass 2: verify a control exists that addresses it.'
      role: Analyst designing controls that actually address the risk they name.
      prompt: You are a Control Design Analyst. You design controls with the risk, the control objective,
        the frequency, the evidence produced, and the owner all specified, and you test whether the control
        would detect or prevent the failure it claims to. You reject a control whose only output is an
        attestation, because a control that produces no testable evidence cannot be audited or relied
        on.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - design-review
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
          - domain-analysis
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-verify3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: qac-03
      name: Verify evidence that the control operates
      summary: 'Verification pass 3: verify evidence that the control operates.'
      role: Collector assembling audit trails that stand up without the collector present.
      prompt: You are an Audit Evidence Collector. You assemble evidence with its source system, extraction
        date, population basis, and completeness check attached, and you state when evidence is a sample
        rather than a population. You flag evidence that cannot be reproduced from the source system,
        because an audit trail that depends on someone remembering how it was made is not an audit trail.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - statistical-analysis
          - data-lineage-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - verified
          - unverified
          - evidence
        properties:
          verified: {}
          unverified: {}
          evidence: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect verification results
      summary: Source-tag every verification result so an unverified item stays attributable.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-unresolved
      kind: condition
      name: Any unverified items?
      summary: Route on collected.unverified is empty.
      config:
        expression: collected.unverified is empty
        branches:
          - label: Clear
            when: clear
          - label: Unverified remain
            when: unverified
    - id: n-resolve
      kind: agent
      templateRef: qac-05
      name: Plan remediation for uncovered obligations
      summary: Close, replace, or explicitly withdraw each unverified item.
      role: Analyst driving nonconformances to verified, effective corrective action.
      prompt: You are a Nonconformance & CAPA Analyst. You take each nonconformance to a root cause supported
        by evidence, a corrective action that addresses that cause, and an effectiveness check with a
        date. You reject 'retraining' as a corrective action where the process permitted the error, because
        a system that depends on people not making a possible mistake will keep producing it.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - decision-analysis
          - evaluation
          - risk-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:qms
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Compliance officer signs off on the obligation register
      summary: Pause for the compliance officer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Regulatory change → verified obligations deliverable, the evidence
        behind it, and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-dedupe
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-2
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-3
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-4
      from: n-dedupe
      to: n-verify3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-5
      from: n-verify1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-6
      from: n-verify2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-7
      from: n-verify3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-8
      from: n-collect
      to: n-unresolved
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-9
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-approval
      kind: control
      condition: clear
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-10
      from: n-unresolved
      to: n-resolve
      kind: control
      condition: unverified
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-11
      from: n-resolve
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-qac-02-edge-12
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
